_comment: Base ML configuration convention. Values here are engineering defaults/placeholders, not results from a trained model. Populated/overridden by later phases (dataset pipeline, training, fine-tuning) per ML_SPEC.md.

dataset.name: PlantVillage
dataset.license: not declared by upstream repository at pinned commit; verify redistribution terms before non-research use
dataset.acquisition_method: git partial clone (--filter=blob:none) + cone sparse-checkout of raw/color; see ml/scripts/acquire_dataset.py

model._comment: Stage 1 (Phase 03/04) and Stage 2 (Phase 05) defaults; see ml/src/models/efficientnet.py.

stage2._comment: See ml/src/training/stage2.py. unfreeze_from is the name prefix of the first backbone layer to unfreeze; everything before it stays frozen.

augmentation._comment: Training split only; never applied to val/test. See ml/src/preprocessing/augmentation.py.
